title: Forget saved Wifi connections created during OEM installation. This did show Wifi connection to end-users after the initial setup, including Wifi passwords.
description: Forget saved Wifi connections created during OEM installation. This did show Wifi connection to end-users after the initial setup, including Wifi passwords.
diff:
diff --git a/bin/oem-config-prepare b/bin/oem-config-prepare
index fba5680..e633819 100755
--- a/bin/oem-config-prepare
+++ b/bin/oem-config-prepare
@@ -26,7 +26,8 @@ if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then
 	rm -f /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/*
 
 	# Potentially sensitive.
-	rm -f /home/oem/.ssh/known_hosts
+	rm -f /home/oem/.ssh/known_hosts \
+	      /etc/netplan/90-*.yaml
 
 	cp -a /usr/lib/oem-config/oem-config.service /lib/systemd/system
 	cp -a /usr/lib/oem-config/oem-config.target /lib/systemd/system
